ARTO.name: Art Object
ARTO.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/ARTO. [measured: 201 DNAM fields in Skyrim.esm, each 4 bytes]

DNAM.name: Art Type
DNAM.note: What the art object is used for: 0 = Magic Casting, 1 = Magic Hit Effect, 2 = Enchantment Effect.

MODL.name: Model
MODL.note: The model, with the MODB, MODT, MODS and MODD fields.

OBND.name: Object Bounds
OBND.note: Always 12 bytes, even when all zero.

EFSH.name: Effect Shader
EFSH.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/EFSH. [measured: 324 EFSH records in Skyrim.esm; the DATA shader runs from 308 to 400 bytes, always a multiple of four]

DATA.name: Shader Data
DATA.note: The shader's data, whose layout is not documented.

KYWD.name: Keyword
KYWD.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/KYWD. [measured: 199 CNAM fields in Skyrim.esm, each 4 bytes]

CNAM.name: Colour
CNAM.note: The colour used to identify the keyword in the editor.

LGTM.name: Lighting Template
LGTM.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/LGTM. [measured: 97 DALC fields in Skyrim.esm, 32 bytes each]

DALC.name: Direct Ambient And Specular Colours
DALC.note: The directional ambient on each of the six sides, the specular colour and the Fresnel power.

DATA.name: Lighting
DATA.note: The ambient, directional and fog colours, the fog near and far distances, the directional rotation, the directional fade, the fog clip distance and power, the fog max, and the two light fade distances.

MGEF.name: Magic Effect
MGEF.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/MGEF. The base's version of this record has a different DATA, so Skyrim's own is used. [measured: 950 MGEF records in Skyrim.esm; DATA is 152 bytes, DNAM 4 and SNDD a run of 8-byte entries]

DATA.name: Data
DATA.note: The effect's main data, 152 bytes. The layout is not documented, so it is read as raw bytes.

DNAM.name: Data
DNAM.note: The effect's data. [measured: 4 bytes in every MGEF]

FULL.name: Full Name
FULL.note: The name shown in the game.

KWDA.name: Keyword
KWDA.note: A KYWD record. There is one per KSIZ.

MDOB.name: Menu Display Object
MDOB.note: The object shown in the menu.

SNDD.name: Sound
SNDD.note: The sounds the effect plays, a run of 8-byte entries with no count of its own.

MSTT.name: Movement Type
MSTT.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/MSTT. [measured: 90 MODS fields in Skyrim.esm]

DATA.name: On Local Map
DATA.note: Whether the movement type applies on the local map.

SNAM.name: Sound
SNAM.note: The sound the movement type plays.

RFCT.name: Reference Effect
RFCT.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/RFCT. [measured: 103 DATA fields in Skyrim.esm, each 12 bytes]

TXST.name: Texture Set
TXST.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/TXST. The textures have a numbered signature: TX00 is the colour map, TX01 the normal map, TX02 the mask, TX03 the tone or glow map, TX04 the detail map, TX05 the environment map, TX06 the multilayer map, which does not occur in Skyrim.esm, and TX07 the glow map. [measured: 186 TX07 fields in Skyrim.esm]

DNAM.name: Flags
DNAM.note: The texture set's flags. Bit 0 means there is no specular map.

OBND.name: Object Bounds
OBND.note: The bounds, as six int16 values.

TX01.name: Normal Map
TX01.note: The normal map's path, in tangent or model space.

TX02.name: Mask
TX02.note: The mask's path, for the environment or the light.

TX03.name: Tone Map
TX03.note: The tone map's path for skins, or the glow map's path for things.

TX04.name: Detail Map
TX04.note: The detail map's path, for the roughness, complexion or age.

TX05.name: Environment Map
TX05.note: The environment map's path, mostly cubemaps.

TX06.name: Multilayer Map
TX06.note: The multilayer map's path. It does not occur in Skyrim.esm.

struct.note: The red channel.

struct.note: The blue channel.

struct.name: unused
struct.note: Always zero.

struct.name: directional_ambient_z_minus
struct.note: The directional ambient on the z- side.

struct.name: specular_color

struct.name: fresnel_power
struct.note: The Fresnel power, from 0 to 1.

struct.name: flags
struct.note: The effect's flags.

struct.name: unknown
